_readme: Which Tatari the last game update moved, and which way.
The wiki publishes what a skill does now; it does not publish what it did
before, so nothing in this file can be scraped. The numbers come from the
patch notes the developers post, read by hand into here. The source field
names which set of notes, so a wrong call can be checked rather than trusted.
A line, not a Tatari. Horde Invasion skills belong to the whole evolution
family -- Frostnip and Frostluna carry the same three -- so a change lands on
every member, and members is that family expanded to slugs. Anything absent
from this file was not touched by the update.
The direction field is the only judgement in here:
buff      every number moved in the player favour
nerf      every number moved against them
adjusted  some of each, so calling it either way would be a lie
Two rules keep that judgement consistent. Faster intervals and shorter
cooldowns count as favourable and longer ones do not. And where a debuff a
Tatari inflicts got weaker, that is a nerf to the Tatari even though the
number went down -- Droppit Sea Fog is the one that catches people.
One patch at a time. These markers are worth having the week an update lands
and misleading three updates later, so when the next notes arrive this file
is rewritten rather than appended to. Leaving lines empty is a coherent
state: the roster simply stops marking anything.
label: Season 2
source: In-game Season Update screen (first read off the Pioneer Server build, 2026-09-16, by .kippy. on Discord)

changes: Flame Fists: Minimum Cooldown 9s → 6s, Maximum Cooldown 13s → 9s
Fervent Fumes: ATK Boost 15% → 25%, DEF Boost 15% → 25%
Pink Protection: Min Trigger Interval 12s → 9s, Max Trigger Interval 20s → 15s
Warm Aura: Min Trigger Interval 8s → 12s, Max Trigger Interval 12s → 18s
Winged Rewind: Min Trigger Interval 10s → 14s, Max Trigger Interval 14s → 18s
Croaker Chant: Minimum Cooldown 10s → 14s, Maximum Cooldown 16s → 20s

_note: The Season 2 notes that are not about one Tatari, as the Season Update
screen lists them. Same Pioneer Server caveat as the rest of this tab:
The chip changes carry their own direction. A number cannot say it on its
own here: Parting Gift paying 40 energizers instead of 200 is a nerf, and
AFK Mode forcing 40 seconds of auto-battle instead of 90 is a buff.
Tatari on this tab is marked in the drafter: chips.json is what the live

groups.title: Changed
items: A Tatari knocked down in battle now gives some of its energizers back. On the Pioneer Server it was confirmed to be 100 energizer.
Horde Invasion skills were adjusted for some Tatari and their evolutions. The changes below are the ones the Season Update screen names; the rest are in the game’s own Horde Invasion interface.
Stage difficulties moved a little: Difficulty 1 is slightly easier, and Difficulties 3 and 4 are slightly harder.

groups.title: Fixed
items: Dewgrub’s Aqua Flutter dealt less damage than it should have in some situations.
